notes.title: Update 1.3.2
notes.content: Fixed a bug where enemies on the compound mode offline mode would not move, due to the navigation AI not being set up.

notes.title: Update 1.3.1
notes.content:
Patchnotes are as follows:

[b]Content Additions: [/b]
- Added "Frost" Map to practice mode

[b]Changes / Fixes: [/b]
- Fixed Project Hardline not working on some Mac computers, by enabling compatibility with a larger range of chipsets.
- Reintroduced the ability to swap weapons with scroll wheel. This can be enabled in settings.
- Bots now respond appropriately to smoke grenades and flashbangs.
- Fixed a small animation bug on the MP5

notes.title: Major Update 1.3
notes.content:
Thank you so much for playing so far! Unfortunately, this may be the last major update or
one of the last updates for Project Hardline as I am shifting my attention more towards other projects
both in game development and outside. I hope you have all enjoyed Project Hardline and I am looking 
forward to making more games for everyone to play!

I have also read most of the suggestions from the community and will take them into note for the next project!

[b]Content Additions:[/b]
- New map: "Frost"
- New weapons: MPL Carbine, MP5
- New equipment: Flashbang, Smoke Grenade
- New sight: 1-4x Spectre Sight, use your scroll wheel to adjust magnification
- Ziplines have now been placed across many of the maps. Interact with their bases to attach yourself
onto them.
- Overhauled movement. Players will now slide down slopes that are too steep
- A few minor map changes to accommodate for the movement overhaul.

[b]Changes:[/b]
- Capturing the Uplink Station now requires holding the interact button while staying still for a short duration.
- The Health Pen now has two uses, each use healing 40 health
- Buffed the P90 by increasing damage and improving recoil
- Increased price of P90 and moved it to an endgame weapon
- Buffed M24 by increasing it's chest one shot range greatly
- Improved M249 recoil when standing 
- More rebalancing and changes to the weapon pool

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- Realigned many of the sights for weapons to make them consistent with each other
- Added a message length limit to chat
- Fixed weapon swapping not working correctly when swapping between similar items
- Fixed the ramp that could not be walked up in Lost Islands Map
- Fixed grenades clipping through objects
- Fixed a bug that allowed you to capture the uplink through the floor
- Many more fixes...

notes.title: Update 1.2.2
notes.content:
The changelog for this update is as follows.

[b]Content Additions:[/b]
- Added new sights to pistols

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Fixed a bug causing a team to instantly win when capturing the uplink. This needs further testing.
- Fixed grenades clipping through walls
- Fix shotguns shooting glass, causing multiple instances of glass breaking.

notes.title: Update 1.2.1
notes.content:
[b]Content[/b]
- Added Shipyard and Fortress maps to the Practice Mode 
- Added a new screen effect when spectating, as well as improving the camera positioning.
- Slightly modified the model positions of the AK15 weapon.

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Fixed Enemy AI behaviour, to stop them from walking backwards when they should not be.
- Fixed an audio bug when spectating
- Fixed the shotgun draw animation
- Fixed playermodel head being visible when spectating

[b]Changes[/b]
- Minor UI changes to the weapon icon background.

notes.title: Project Hardline Update 1.2
notes.content:
[b]Major Content Updates[/b]
- Added a new singleplayer mode against bots (yes finally). This mode is in beta, expect new maps and modes to it soon hopefully.
- Added Scout Sniper Rifle
- Added AK15 Assault Rifle
- Small rework of Fortress Map
- Overhaul of spectator system

[b]Minor Content Updates and Changes[/b]
- Massive CPU optimisations, to make the game run much smoother.
- Graphical updates, reworked lighting on all maps
- Added new blood particles and effects, headshot kills will now have a special particle effect.
- Some new animations 
- Added a censor to the chat. 
- Improved Ragdolls to preserve the momentum of characters
- Added windows and glass
- Better zeroes to all scopes and optics, they should much accurately hit where you aim now.
- Added bullet penetration through doors
- Fixed / Added back suppression mechanic
- Improved thermal scope image.

[b]Balancing Changes[/b]
- Large buff to grenades, they can be thrown much further and deal more damage at distance
- Large buff to stim pens.
- Decreased ADS walk speed of M24 sniper rifle
- Increased cost of M24 Sniper Rifle
- Buffed the M45 pistol, making it deal more damage at range.

[b]Fixes and Technical[/b]
- Fixed bugs which caused CPU issues.
- Fixed some weapons being able to clip through walls with suppressors.
- Fixed players disconnecting from a server, breaking the server.
- Updated Unity Version.
- Many more other fixes...

notes.title: Update 1.11
notes.content: Fixed the Mac version not running correctly.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Changelog:

[b]Content: [/b]

- Complete overhaul of optics, they are much more consistent and also completely visually different.
- Added Low Power Optic.
- Added Holographic Sight.
- Added Text Chat, this can be disabled in settings. 
- Several Map Changes and fixes.
- Overhaul of bullet tracers. Different weapons will also have different tracers to show what type of weapon is fired at you. 

[b]Bug Fixes: [/b]

- Fixed a bug where visual effect for healing would not consistently play.
- Fixed collision issues on many maps.
- Other general fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 and 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed Incorrect colliders / hitboxes for walls on the Compound map.
- Fixed Round Win Bug, where a team could win twice by defeating other team and capturing uplink at the same time.
- Fixed Shooting range pickups: Knife being represented as a Glock
- Fixed a bug that caused weapon attachments to not change weapon recoil correctly.

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
- Made world UI icons shrink when looked at so they do not obscure vision.
- Increase sensitivity slider: This is to allow for overall higher sensitivities in game.
- Added scroll wheel changing weapons
- Highlight player in scoreboard

[h2]Balancing Changes[/h2]
- Nerfed M249 by adding more recoil.
- Buffed X22 by decreasing recoil.
